blurb: Robert Scoble is a prominent tech blogger, author, and entrepreneur known for his early coverage of Microsoft and Silicon Valley. He posts about emerging technologies, including AI, augmented reality, and startups, and has over 200,000 followers on X.
credibility_note: Scoble has faced criticism for overly optimistic tech predictions and was involved in a 2017 sexual misconduct allegation, which he denied.
